name: Amaya Miu
source: The school nurse. She is infamous due to her unmotivated personality and for the fact that she spends most of her time in the school's infirmary playing video games, with the students having given her the nickname of "the hikikomori of the school's infirmary". But because of her beauty and kind nature, Miu is popular with the boys. She is also [url=/c35467]Ayuno's[/url] older sister.
